go.name: Dr Daniel Kolawole Olukoya
go.biography:
Dr Daniel Kolawole Olukoya is the founder and General Overseer of Mountain of Fire and Miracles Ministries. Born in Akure, Ondo State, he studied in Akure and Lagos and became a Christian while attending Methodist Boys’ High School.

He studied microbiology at the University of Lagos and went on to earn a doctorate in molecular genetics at the University of Reading in the United Kingdom. On returning to Nigeria, he worked at the Nigerian Institute of Medical Research in Yaba and contributed to scientific research and teaching.

In 1989, he called a prayer meeting in his living room attended by 24 people. The gatherings grew and eventually developed into MFM, which held its first church service in 1994. His ministry is known for Bible teaching, prayer, holiness, evangelism and deliverance. He has also authored many Christian books.

wife.name: Pastor (Mrs) Shade Olukoya
wife.biography:
Pastor (Mrs) Shade Olukoya serves alongside her husband in the leadership of MFM Worldwide. She grew up in a Christian family and pursued studies in fashion, fine art and interior decoration in London.

An artist and illustrator, she has contributed artwork to many of Dr Olukoya’s books. She is also a singer and minister whose music and messages have been part of church services and special programmes.

She serves as International Coordinator of the MFM Women’s Foundation, which supports women through literacy and practical skills initiatives.
